policy.breach: strictly above either bound against either reference
policy.creep: a breaching entry strictly exceeds a previous maximum or twice its frozen development reference, per reference/metric
policy.development_reference: first verified development observation per condition x dataset, frozen by journal order
policy.identity: digest of mode, recipe SHA256 and declared cell coordinates
policy.maxima: all verified observations; condition x dataset x reference x metric
policy.reporting: immediate local alert; orchestrator conveys alerts immediately and entries at block boundaries
